payload.coverage_scope: Exact locked-eight authority plus the F23 Lambda non-authority boundary; not an exhaustive inventory of every SZL formula or theorem.

formulas.caveat: Does not prove correctness of the replayed function or the truth of its inputs.
formulas.name: Replay-Hash Determinism
formulas.scope: Pure deterministic replay stability for identical function and input/trace.

formulas.caveat: The proof applies only when every admitted edge satisfies the encoded invariant.
formulas.name: Khipu DAG Acyclicity
formulas.scope: Append-only Khipu graphs satisfying the strict backward-edge invariant.

formulas.caveat: Does not by itself prove delivery, durability, or ordering of an external transport.
formulas.name: Chaski FIFO Ordering
formulas.scope: The encoded append-at-back, drain-from-front Chaski queue model.

formulas.caveat: Does not prove fairness or conservation for arbitrary economic or social systems.
formulas.name: Ayni Reciprocity Conservation
formulas.scope: The encoded additive credit-then-equal-debit balance identity.

formulas.caveat: Additive fragment only; not nonlinear Kuramoto synchronization.
formulas.name: Kuramoto Additive Fragment
formulas.scope: Additive distributive coupling fragment over natural-number terms.

formulas.caveat: Does not implement or prove a specific encoder, decoder, storage system, or corruption model.
formulas.name: Reed-Solomon RS(10,6) Recovery Arithmetic
formulas.scope: Arithmetic for 10 total shards, 6 required data shards, and up to 4 erasures.

formulas.caveat: Additive/monotone scaffolding only; not the full physical Bekenstein bound.
formulas.name: Bekenstein Additive Scaffolding
formulas.scope: Additive and monotone natural-number budget scaffolding.

formulas.caveat: Does not prove monotonicity of an external clock, database sequence, or distributed transport.
formulas.name: Khipu Emit Monotonicity
formulas.scope: The encoded List.range sequence-log and append-next-index emit model.

formulas.caveat: Unconditional uniqueness is open/false under the bare encoded A1-A5 assumptions; Lambda is advisory.
formulas.name: Lambda Aggregator Uniqueness
formulas.scope: Conditional factorized uniqueness theorem plus an unconditional counterexample boundary.

policy.applicability_rule: A locked proof constrains execution only after an explicit, evidence-bound applicability decision.
policy.authorization_rule: No formula, including a locked-proven formula, independently authorizes a consequential action.
policy.identity_rule: Formula identity and maturity are read only from this digest-bound, commit-pinned authority record.
policy.lambda_rule: F23 Lambda remains Conjecture 1 advisory and is excluded from every action authorization basis.
policy.namespace_rule: Formal F-identifiers and the 21 callable szl-formulas functions remain separate namespaces until a proved mapping exists.
policy.training_rule: Training may teach formula use and abstention, but runtime authority is always re-established from this record.
